newsitem.title: USA: Dade Cty plan would reward unsolicited proposals.
newsitem.headline: Dade Cty plan would reward unsolicited proposals.

text.p: Bond underwriters who make unsolicited proposals to save money for Dade County would be rewarded with the senior manager's slot if the deal goes through, under a proposal Tuesday by Commissioner Jimmy Morales.
"We're trying to create a little more financial incentive for people to come up with good ideas," said Morales, who chairs the county's Budget, Finance and Public Trust Committee.
At present, members of the county's bond underwriting pool are awarded the senior manager slot on a rotating basis. Morales' proposal would apply only to firms in that pool.
Unsolicited proposals from other firms would still be considered, but the firms could not participate in the syndicate if the proposal is accepted.

Instead, Morales' proposal would give them "extra credit points" the next time the county circulates RFQ's for bond underwriters. That would increase their chances of being in the next pool for Dade deals.
The proposal underwent a first reading Tuesday and would have to undergo a second reading before the committee forwards it to the full commission.
